description: Two-stage interpreted search: searches the web for a topic, fetches top results, and compiles a structured summary organized by source. No LLM involved — extracts key sentences and organizes them. Needs a search provider, like web_search.

depth.description: Research depth: "quick" (3 sources, shorter text), "standard" (5 sources, default), or "deep" (10 sources, more text)

maxSources.description: Maximum number of sources to fetch and include (1-10, default 5)

name: research_topic
